create_L2Loss: create an L2Loss instance to compute mean squared error between predicted and target wave signals
create_AmplitudeLoss: create an AmplitudeLoss instance with a sample rate to compute STFT-based amplitude difference loss
create_PhaseLoss: create a PhaseLoss instance with a sample rate to compute angular phase difference loss between signals
use_Loss_forward: use the Loss forward method to compute a scalar loss value from predicted and target wave tensors
customize_mask_beginning: customize the mask_beginning parameter on any Loss subclass to skip initial samples during loss computation
